controlPolicy: Each control names a semantic counterfactual implementation defect and the fixture case whose expectation kills it. The U4 verify leg must demonstrate every kill against the production build; a control that no test kills blocks closure.

controls.counterfactual: Stop is disabled unless status is playing
The badge renders a locally predicted status instead of the accepted projection
A same-generation notification with an equal sequence repaints the badge
A notification with a stale plan revision repaints the now block
Restart or section-play dispatches two controller intents from the UI
The scrubber loses role=slider, its keyboard law, or its exact labels
A keyboard seek reads the interpolated display playhead instead of the committed one
Space toggles playback while a text field is focused
An instrument change while playing claims immediate effect
A refused count-in toggle still shows enabled
Interrupted presents as ordinary Paused with no trusted-gesture resume affordance
An audio fault disables chart editing or export
After Stop settles, the UI shows the playhead anywhere but the run startBeat
The rAF sweep writes application state or dispatches a command
